_doc: ADR-0027 D2: machine-consumed derived config. Floors are pre-registered (ADR-0015 D2, corrected by ADR-0019 D5); targets are the ADR-0018 D2 band's warning boundary (recall target = match b2's core recall, score target = official ranking floor 0.80 aspiration). Changes require an ADR (enforced by scripts/check-bench-thresholds.js).

corpus._fingerprint_def: sha256 over lines of JSON.stringify(entry) joined with LF (EOL-independent)

_doc_probe_gates: ADR-0029 D2/D3: structural zero-miss smoke gates over bench/polygraph/probes.jsonl (7 violation + 7 benign). Band semantics do not apply to zero floors. probe-recall floor = 1 (0 misses); probe-fp floor = 0 (0 false positives).
_doc_probe_coverage: ADR-0030 D1: corpus structural floor (interval coverage replaces exactly-once; growth is allowed, shrinkage below floor is not).
_doc_judge_bias_gates: ADR-0031 D2/D3: judge bias calibration metrics over judge-twins.jsonl v1.1 pairs (style-control / length-control / bias-probe), consumed by bench/polygraph/check-judge-bias.js. Tier rules per ADR-0031 D3: confirmatory gates fail closed; observational gates record and must carry review_at + promote_if (overdue = STALE, refused by check-bench-thresholds.js); swap_order is observational-only forever (ADR-0031 R3).

judge_bias_gates.promote_if: two consecutive 6-month re-verifications completed on a landed scoring-mode judge; promotion itself requires an ADR amending ADR-0031 D2
never auto-promoted; ADR-0031 R3 rejects position-swap gating unless new evidence revisits it
